title: Dial-a-Code
description: Simulate a circular dial and count zero crossings.
writeup:
## Approach

A dial numbered 0–99 wraps around circularly. Instructions move it left or right by a given amount.

## Part 1

Apply each instruction as modular arithmetic on the dial position. After each instruction, check if the dial lands exactly on 0.

## Part 2

Now count every time the dial *passes through* zero, not just lands on it. Simulate step-by-step: move one position at a time and check for the 0→99 or 99→0 wraparound on each step.
